project.name: ag-associates-root

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: AG Associates is an AI-driven legal operations platform for panel advocates in India, automating zero-staff title searches, property registration (NeSL/IGR/GRAS portals), bank panel operations, and white-label SaaS delivery. The system orchestrates AI agents, RPA automation, a document pipeline, and a mobile PWA for field executives.

tour.title: Monorepo Architecture
tour.description: The project is structured as a Turborepo monorepo with two main workspaces: ag-associates-ai (Python/FastAPI backend and legacy frontend) and ag-platform (Next.js web app, React Native mobile app, and shared packages). This split cleanly separates the AI automation backend from the modern platform UI.

tour.title: AI Backend Entry & Routes
tour.description: The FastAPI application entry point (main.py) sets up middleware, CORS, and mounts route handlers for the NOI pipeline, document search, case management, automation triggers, and health checks. The router module (routing.py) centralizes URL prefixing and dependency injection.

tour.title: NOI Pipeline Automation
tour.description: The Notice of Intent (NOI) pipeline is the core business flow. noi_pipeline.py orchestrates the multi-step process: intake from email, extract case details, compute fees, generate notices, file with NeSL/IGR, and notify stakeholders. noc_automation.py handles the scheduling and retry logic for batch processing.

tour.title: Portal Integrations & e-Filing
tour.description: The backend integrates with three government portals. nesl_client.py provides a 3-mode NeSL client (API, RPA, or mock) for electronic filing. igr_executor.py automates IGR stamp duty payments with 18 configurable Playwright selectors. gras_client.py handles GRAS portal submissions.

tour.title: AI Agents & Automation Crew
tour.description: A multi-agent system handles legal tasks: Aisha (paralegal), Sarah (scheduler), Scribe (document writer), Horseman (RPA), Vigil (monitoring), Tinker (maintenance), and Auditor (compliance). The agent orchestrator in agents/main.py routes tasks to the appropriate agent based on intent classification.

tour.title: Services Layer
tour.description: The platform services provide reusable business logic: case_service.py handles case lifecycle, noi_service.py manages NOI state transitions, document_service.py handles generation and storage, email_service.py manages IMAP/SMTP intake, and telegram_service.py provides bot notifications to field executives.

tour.title: Database & Supabase Schema
tour.description: Supabase provides the PostgreSQL backend with Row Level Security. Migrations define tables for cases, documents, users, payments, and NOI records. The schema supports multi-tenant white-label SaaS through organization-scoped access policies.

tour.title: Platform Web Dashboard
tour.description: The Next.js platform UI provides an executive dashboard with case management, office administration, document storage, and advisor tools. It uses React Server Components, Tailwind CSS with a gold/black brand theme, and Zustand for client state management.

tour.title: Mobile PWA for Field Executives
tour.description: A React Native Expo mobile app serves field executives with a 4-tab bottom navigation (activity, cases, dashboard, settings). It supports offline access via local storage, push notifications, and biometric authentication. The PWA manifest enables installability on Android/iOS.

tour.title: Infrastructure & Deployment
tour.description: Production runs on a Hetzner VPS via Docker Compose with Caddy reverse proxy handling 6 subdomains (app, dashboard, api, n8n, docs, intake) with auto-TLS. GitHub Actions provide CI/CD via a self-hosted runner. Node 22 images use native WebSocket for Supabase realtime.

tour.title: Data Flow & Integration Points
tour.description: The system follows an event-driven architecture: email intake triggers NOI creation, which feeds into the multi-agent pipeline, updates Supabase via realtime subscriptions, and notifies field executives via Telegram/Expo push. RAG gracefully degrades without sentence-transformers in production.
